facts.text: Deep Exfoliation For Even Skin Tone, Texture & Glow

A multi-purpose exfoliator formulated with Glycolic Acid in free acid form (at 8%) to help in natural cell turnover and effective exfoliation. Combined with bamboo water for hydrating and soothing skin.
"Superb with my dead skin totally exfoliate my skin love using the product on daily basis." - Priya M
Multi-purpose exfoliator for face, body, underarms & scalp

Delivers an optimal concentration of 8% Glycolic Acid in free acid form to promote effective exfoliation and natural cell turnover. Free acid form represents how much acid is available in non-ionized form and is actually able to work effectively on the skin
Formulated with Bamboo Water that has regenerative properties that help sooth & calm skin. It also doubles up as an excellent hydrator
High quality ingredients including Glycolic acid sourced from Chemours, USA
Concerns: Dull Skin, Uneven Tone & Texture
The product has been evaluated for safety through patch testing under the supervision of a Dermatologist.
Take few drops into your palms & gently press into face, body, or neck until fully absorbed. Leave overnight. Can be applied with cotton pads as well. Layer it with your preferred moisturizer.
For external use only. Patch test recommended before use. Store in cool, dry place.
When to use: PM. Start with twice a week, & gradually increase frequency. Do not use more than once a day.

Glycolic acid with free acid form permits it to work at 08% concentration and helps unleash the true power of the molecule. It penetrates the skin's epidermis layer promoting cell turnover to reduce impurities and dead cells for improved skin texture.
Bamboo water supports the formulation to directly affect the skin by soothing and reducing skin irritation. With its regenerating properties it revitalizes, repairs & renews skin.

Aqua, Glycolic Acid, Bambusa Vulgaris (Bamboo) Water, Sodium Hydroxide, Propanediol, Ethoxydiglycol, Polysorbate-20, Sodium Hyaluronate, Sodium PCA, Aminomethyl Propanol, Phenoxyethanol, Ethylhexylglycerin, Trisodium Ethylenediamine Disuccinate
Pregnant or breastfeeding individuals should not use this product without consulting their healthcare provider first.
